scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:contracts && pnpm test:cre
scripts.deploy:anvil: DEPLOY_NETWORK=anvil DEPLOY_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) pnpm -s -F scripts run with-env --cwd contracts -- forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --broadcast && pnpm gen:abi
scripts.deploy:base-sepolia: DEPLOY_NETWORK=base-sepolia DEPLOY_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) pnpm -s -F scripts run with-env --cwd contracts -- forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url base_sepolia --broadcast --verify && pnpm gen:abi
scripts.verify:base-sepolia: DEPLOY_NETWORK=base-sepolia DEPLOY_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD) pnpm -s -F scripts run with-env --cwd contracts -- forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url base_sepolia --broadcast --resume --verify
